title: From Almost All to All but Finitely Many: Barriers and a Spectral Reduction for Restricted Goldbach Sums
content: We give a single, self-contained and fully audited account of the analytic programme on therestricted weighted Goldbach sum Ra,q(N) = sum_{p1+p2=N, p1≡a (mod q)} (log p1)(log p2),Ma,q(N) = C2 S(N)/phi(q) * N, and its exceptional set Ea,q(X) = {N ≤ X, N even: Ra,q(N) = 0}. -Part I (Unconditional core). We establish, with complete proofs and certified numericalconstants: an effective almost-all theorem with explicit constant K = 2C(1,4) ≤ 38.82; auniform minor-arc L4 bound with κsafe ≤ 4.40; the exact diagonal second-momentconstant G/(2φ(q)); a sub-exponential exceptional-set bound #Ea,q(X) <<q X exp(-sqrt(log X / R))with Stechkin's constant R = 9.6459; structural rigidity results (gap bound with exponent0.525, non-consecutiveness, and three-term progression avoidance); and the decay||1Ea,q||_{U2[1,X]} -> 0. Every result in Part I is [PROVED] and uses no unproved hypothesis. -Part II (Structural obstructions). We prove three theorems that close all classical routesto unconditional finiteness: the Double-Pole Convolution Obstruction (showing that a fixedSiegel zero β1 < 1 contributes only O(N^{2β1 - 1}) = o(N) to the error, thusretracting all "Siegel-contradiction" finiteness claims); the Borel-Cantelli Divergence Barrier(mu(A_N) >> 1/N so sum_N mu(A_N) = infinity, retracting the naive rarity argument); and theETK Dimensional Explosion (the Erdos-Turan-Koksma error grows like 3k(N) with k(N) -> infinity,defeating Baker-type bounds term by term, and retracting the LI+HBL route via ETK). We also prove that the classical circle method saturates exactly at GRH. -Part III (The Gowers-Spectral Bridge). We construct a conditional reduction of finitenessto the Uniform Spectral Gap (USG) hypothesis - a statistical regularity condition on thezero-sum graph of Dirichlet L-functions, strictly weaker than GRH. Under USG, the exceptionalset is finite with an effectively computable threshold N_0(q); for q = 4 we obtain N_0(4) ≤ 1016under USG with d_eff = 4. We prove that the Montgomery pair correlation conjecture implies asmoothed spectral gap lambda_2(A~_sm) ≤ 4(log T)-2, and we identify the precise remaining[OPEN] sub-lemma: whether Montgomery-GUE implies lambda_2(A~_orig) << (log T)-1/2 - anobstacle that reduces to controlling the additive energy of zeros of order > 2.
